description:
About Life360

Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

About the Team

At Life360, the Marketing team is a highly valued contributor to the business. From creating demand to converting that demand to expanding our relationships with members, the Marketing team is at the forefront of telling the Life360 story and how it can help make everyday family life better. We prioritize bold thinking, principled risks and entrepreneurial thinking. And, we give our marketers the freedom and autonomy to make the decisions they feel are best for the brand and the business. It's an exciting time to be on the Life360 global Marketing team!

About the Job

Reporting to the VP of Integrated Marketing, the Senior Director of Performance Marketing owns demand acceleration and conversion across consumer acquisition in our core and emerging markets including US, UK, Australia, Canada and Germany, with additional markets coming online each year. You will partner closely with the Senior Director of Integrated Marketing to close the funnel. Their work creates the demand, yours accelerates and converts it, and the two only work as one motion.

This is a builder's role at the frontier of how paid media gets done. You will lead a team and a set of agency and technology partners across paid social, search, app-install, programmatic and App Store Optimization (ASO) channels, and you will push us to build, buy and deploy AI and agentic systems that plan, bid, create, test and optimize media faster and smarter than a manual process ever could. You own the day-to-day: the channel plans, the budgets, the bidding and creative-testing engines, the experimentation roadmap and the reporting that tells us what is working.

The international scope is the part that makes this role different. Each market is at a different stage of brand awareness and subscription maturity, so the right performance playbook, efficiency target and level of automation will vary by market.

You will partner deeply with marketing leaders across creative and social, product marketing, journey marketing, comms and with functional teams outside marketing (data science and analytics, design, finance) and product/eng teams (subscription growth, devices). Your performance connects directly to the company's key goals — brand, free user growth, and financial — and this is a high visibility role.

The US-based salary range for this position is $171,000 to $266,000. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. 

What You'll Do

  • Own the performance marketing strategy and budget accountability for acquisition efficiency and free user growth across markets including US, UK, AU, CA and DE, driving toward the company’s goals for MAU and Quality New Reg. 
  • Scale spend profitably across paid social, search, app-install networks, programmatic, and emerging channels, setting the targets for CAC, ROAS, payback and LTV that guide where the next dollar goes.
  • Own App Store Optimization (ASO) as a core acquisition lever, including keyword strategy, metadata, creative and screenshot testing, Custom Product Pages and store listing localization by market, to lift organic installs and store conversion rate.
  • Be responsible for and drive AI and agentic systems for media and optimization — including automated bidding and budget allocation, creative generation and testing at scale, anomaly detection, forecasting and reporting. 
  • Run a rigorous experimentation program across channels, audiences, creative, landing experiences and funnel stages, and turn results into scaled playbooks.
  • Work hand in hand with the Senior Director of Integrated Marketing so brand and demand creation feed performance, and performance learnings sharpen brand and demand creation. Share one view of the funnel, one calendar and one set of goals.
  • Partner with creativel on a high-velocity creative testing engine, including adaptation and localization for international markets.
  • Translate global strategy into market-level media plans, flighting and budgets, working with regional agency partners and in-market teams on local nuance: media landscape, competitive set, cultural context, language and regulatory and privacy requirements.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics and Finance on attribution, incrementality testing, marketing mix and econometric modeling that hold up at both a global and a market level, including the practical realities of measuring smaller markets with less data.
  • Own the performance budget day to day across markets: build the plans, track pacing, reallocate as results dictate, and serve as the VP's right hand on forecast and performance.
  • Lead the development of metric dashboards in partnership with the Data Analytics team and agency partners, giving leadership full visibility into performance across channels and markets, and run the forums where those insights get shared with leadership and other vested constituents.
  • Lead, coach and grow a high performing team working across time zones, and hold agency partners to a high standard.

What We're Looking For

  • 15+ years of performance marketing experience, with 4+ years leading teams in the app marketing space.
  • Proven success scaling app businesses. You have taken a consumer app from early traction to significant, profitable scale, with a track record of growing spend while holding or improving efficiency, and can show the numbers.
  • Hands-on experience building or using AI and agentic models for media and optimization. You have put AI to work in production, for example in automated bidding and budgeting, creative generation and testing, forecasting, or agent-driven campaign management, and can speak to what worked, what didn't and the results.
  • Deep expertise across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Pinterest, Reddit), search, app-install networks, Apple Search Ads and programmatic, and deep fluency in mobile measurement (MMPs such as AppsFlyer), Google privacy-preserving frameworks) and a privacy-first landscape.
  • Consumer subscription experience strongly preferred. Freemium model experience is highly beneficial.
  • Experience running performance marketing across multiple countries at once, building an efficient portfolio of acquisition across different strategies and market maturities.
  • Strong understanding of attribution, incrementality testing, marketing mix and econometric modeling, including the practical realities of measuring smaller markets with less data.
  • Strong analytical and technical fluency: comfortable with SQL, dashboards and working directly with data scientists and engineers to build custom tooling, models and automation.
  • Experience managing agency and technology partners, including regional or local-market agencies.
  • Belief that performance and brand building work as one motion, and the ability to work in lockstep with an Integrated Marketing counterpart toward shared goals.
  • Exceptional cross-functional collaborator who can work effectively across time zones.
  • Stellar communicator. Can distill complex stories down and communicate persuasively in both written and verbal modalities.
  • While data-informed, embraces the grayscale nature of marketing and complements empiricism with judgment and intuition.
  • A strong leader of people and someone who truly buys into our values.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference 

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. 
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. 
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. 

Our Commitment to Belonging

Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway.
